The Shoebox Problem

⏰ Time Vampire

5+ hours/month manually entering receipts. That's 60 hours/year you could spend on literally anything else.

💸 Lost Deductions

Missing receipts = missing deductions. Average small business loses $2,000+ in unclaimed deductions yearly.

😰 Tax Season Panic

March 1st: "Where did I put that receipt from August?" Spoiler: you'll never find it.

🚫 No Visibility

Can't see spending patterns. Can't catch waste. Flying blind until year-end accountant tells you what happened.

The Automated Solution

📸 Snap & Done

Take a photo from any device. AI extracts vendor, amount, date, and category automatically. No typing.

🧠 Smart Categorization

AI learns your spending patterns. Home Depot always goes to "Materials." Gas stations to "Vehicle Expenses."

☁️ Auto-Sync

Receipts sync to your accounting software instantly. Bookkeeper sees them. Accountant gets them. You're done.

🔍 Instant Search

"Show me all receipts over $500 from Q2." Found in 2 seconds. Tax audit? No sweat.

How It Works (30 Seconds)

1️⃣

Snap a Photo

Use your phone. Anywhere. Receipt crumpled? No problem. Coffee stain? AI reads through it. The app works with terrible photos.

2️⃣

AI Does the Work

In 5 seconds, the AI reads the receipt, extracts every detail, matches it to your chart of accounts, and flags anything weird.

3️⃣

You're Done

Receipt is stored, categorized, and synced to QuickBooks/Xero. Digital copy stored forever. Physical receipt? Shred it.

Best Receipt Apps: Our Honest Take

We set up the tool that fits your business. Here are the top 4 we recommend:

Dext (formerly Receipt Bank)
Best for: High volume (50+ receipts/month)
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ $40/month
Expensify
Best for: Teams + expense reports
⭐⭐⭐⭐ $20/month
Hubdoc (Xero)
Best for: Already using Xero
⭐⭐⭐⭐ Included with Xero
AutoEntry
Best for: Line-item detail (invoices, bills)
⭐⭐⭐⭐ $24/month

Note: We don't sell software. We configure and integrate whatever works best for your workflow.
